study.question: Which existing context field sources should receive auxiliary supervision through task-conditioned history adapters: encoded user identity, the complementary fields, or both? Can identity-only transfer improve click AUC over the incumbent at unchanged learned capacity and justified measured cost?
study.hypothesis: Observation: adapter-only auxiliary context transfer reaches click AUC0.6670575100 versus0.6668051957 with both context paths blocked, but direct tower-only transfer reaches0.6668223632 and both-enabled0.6669000087. Item-adapter gradients harm click AUC; task-group restriction and history-row restriction also fail to beat all-context transfer. This motivates a different source contrast, not a conclusion that previous gates worked. Provisional mechanism: auxiliary labels tied to user/category/brand may most usefully shape the existing encoded user identity through personalized history corrections, while common profile/exposure fields may receive conflicting auxiliary updates. Identity-only adapter transfer should beat other-only and all-fields transfer. No local field-resolved gradients have yet been measured; this is a falsifiable hypothesis, not established negative transfer.

nearest_work.source_ref: https://arxiv.org/html/2308.13537v2 (STEM, Method Eq4 and Which feature fields should be task-specific/Table5; primary text read this turn)
nearest_work.difference: STEM already studies shared/task-specific embeddings, stop-gradient and field subsets. This suite introduces no task-specific embedding tables or learned expert gates: it isolates two field-source backward edges in an inherited compressed-history adapter with unchanged forward values and capacity. Neither stop-gradient nor field-specific task sharing is claimed novel. Novelty of the precise combination remains unverified.

INFNet supplies task-conditioned interactions via categorical, sequence and task tokens with proxies. This suite retains the existing task adapter and summary moments, changes only field-source auxiliary backward access, and adds no proxy stack. External effectiveness is not local evidence.

study.proposed_difference: Add two boolean architecture flags aux_adapter_identity_context_grad and aux_adapter_other_context_grad. On auxiliary training adapter inputs only, retain or detach context slices by the actual FeatureMap user_fields order. Identity is exactly the existing encoded user_id field; the complement is all other inherited non-item/non-action fields. The pinned upstream schema confirms this categorical field exists; the live FeatureMap must confirm it before host execution. All/both-enabled returns the original tensor, neither returns detach(), mixed cases concatenate unchanged slices. No arithmetic modification to values, new lookup, current-label gating, parameters, persistent buffers, RNG or normalization recomputation. Four complete standalone modules form the2x2 design; no training is launched in this phase.
predictions: Predeclared directional test: adapter_identity_only click AUC exceeds adapter_fields_all and adapter_other_only; adapter_fields_all must first bridge incumbent0.6670575100016033. Selection is full-population click AUC only. An effect below0.0001 is preliminary numerical/seed-sensitive evidence rather than a consequential improvement.

If identity drives useful transfer, AUC(identity_only)-AUC(none) is positive and larger than AUC(other_only)-AUC(none). Compute both identity simple effects at other off/on, both other-field simple effects at identity off/on, and difference-of-differences AUC(all)-AUC(identity)-AUC(other)+AUC(none); AUC nonlinearity means this is an algorithmic contrast, not an additive physiological mechanism.

At fixed learned weights and buffers, all variants produce equal four-task predictions and native Dice buffer updates in train and eval; click-loss gradients match. Auxiliary per-field context-input Jacobians follow the declared gates after opening each adapter final zero layer in a disposable diagnostic clone. Auxiliary item/scorer edge ownership is inherited.

All/none same-seed outputs should bridge g0-r0034-context_all and g0-r0034-context_none, respectively; capacity remains32129765 total and336549 dense parameters. Mixed field concatenation may add small overhead: measure rather than assume equivalent runtime.

Report all four task AUC/Logloss, auxiliary mean separately, inherited history slices including empty histories, peak memory, training/allocation/wall cost and inference throughput/p50/p95. The incumbent has material auxiliary quality deficits versus DIN, which must remain visible even if click improves.
falsifiers: If identity_only fails to beat all_fields, identity-only restriction is unsuccessful for this implementation. If all_fields remains strongest, retain the incumbent and interpret useful joint sharing as unresolved; do not treat this as a refutation of all field-sensitive designs.
If other_only exceeds identity_only, the directional personalization hypothesis is contradicted. If neither restricted cell improves on none, the proposed source interpretation lacks support.
If all/none cannot reproduce prior anchors within host-documented numeric tolerance, stop interpretation and diagnose source/config, gradient and buffer differences before another charged execution.

Forward/buffer mismatch, changed click Jacobian, unplanned auxiliary item/scorer gradients, changed learned capacity, nonfinite BF16/sparse backward, unavailable field or checkpoint failure invalidates the contrast.
No source/field/stop-gradient novelty or repeated support follows from a single seed, adaptive validation winner, same-seed bridge or an unaudited external effectiveness claim.
alternative_explanations: One training seed and many preceding adaptive comparisons; no independence or statistical significance claim
Identity is one high-cardinality field while its complement has more fields and different update frequencies; this is not a matched-cardinality or matched-gradient-norm comparison
Shared dense global clipping, optimizer histories, batch-coupled tower Dice and possible embedding-table aliases can couple nominally isolated paths

The effect may reflect unequal gradient magnitude, number of field embeddings, sparse Adagrad accumulator changes or convergence in the one-pass recipe rather than identity semantics. A later equal-gradient-budget contrast would be needed before such a semantic claim.

Auxiliary labels are future user/category/brand co-occurrences rather than ad-specific attribution. The offline released prefix visibility and whole-window vocab/static snapshots limit causal and deployment interpretations.
No per-field gradient diagnostics or paired user-cluster bootstrap have been supplied. Absence of such evidence is a missing diagnostic, not evidence for a field mechanism.
